name: WorldConnectionsMap
job: Show where a business operates or ships to, as a dotted world map with glowing arcs linking locations
visitor_action: hover/focus a location to highlight its connections and show its label; keyboard tab through locations
mobile: map scales to container width; camera eases to the selection and pushes the map above a bottom telemetry panel; collision-aware labels show only the active location plus up to 3 that fit
motion: Dots sweep west→east like a scanner with a lit band, markers popping in behind the sweep; arcs trace in once the band passes, then comet heads run the routes with trailing light and a landing ring at each destination; hover/focus springs the camera to the selected route, a light pool warms the dots around the city and its arcs re-trace outward from it (reduced-motion: fully-drawn static map with lit rails, no sweep, comets or rings)

art_direction: Mission control: near-black blue console ground with a faint green-teal atmosphere, slate land dots lit brighter near the cities, routes as phosphor-green light trails with white-hot comet heads and landing rings, a spring camera that eases to the selected route, and a flat telemetry HUD (self-hosted Wix Madefor grotesk for names, tabular mono for coordinates and distances) with hairline borders and no glass. Light variant: day chart-room paper, deep-green routes, additive glow off.
